title: Puzzle 5d Suggestion Parity
description: Puzzle 5d must show brush suggestions on grips like puzzle 2d and 3d. Unified kind catalogs must carry per-part-kind grip templates and meshUrl, merge 2d and 3d source metas, and project back to embedded canvases.
summary:
Implemented puzzle 5d brush suggestion parity (merged 2d+3d kind catalogs with grip templates and meshUrl) and paired brush preview sync across flat and volume surfaces.

Brush preview sync:
- Added Puzzle5dBrushPairedSync + puzzle5dFlatRendererRef in puzzle/5d/react
- Added puzzle3dBrushPairedSyncRef bridge in puzzle/3d/react BrushSession
- Host bridge maps engagement candidate picks by semantic {nodeKind, targetHandleIndex} not raw index
- Mounted sync component in puzzle 5d play chrome

Tests: kind catalog suggestion parity + brush paired sync unit tests pass. Pre-existing applyBrushPlacementToModel fastener test still fails.
